name: Sagami Kaoru
source:
Grade: 3rd year, Momiji Group
Affiliation: Track Club, Student Council Vice President

The vice president of the student council who is a playgirl. She likes making fun of [url=/c13085]Akira[/url] since his reactions are always cute and amusing. Behind that playgirl mask though is quite the mysterious character. 

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
